title: Senior Engineer
jobDescription: Jaipur, IN Nature – Scope of Job The Manufacturing Quality Engineer is responsible for ensuring product quality, process compliance, testing effectiveness, and continuous improvement across manufacturing operations. The role has both technical and people-management responsibilities, requiring leadership of a team of approximately 30–40 operators, inspectors, and technicians while maintaining adherence to quality standards, safety requirements, and production targets. Industrial Engineering & Process Documentation Projects & Programs To lead and manage manufacturing quality operations by ensuring adherence to quality standards, driving continuous improvement, resolving quality issues through structured problem-solving, and managing a team of 30–40 personnel to achieve organizational quality, safety, and productivity objectives. RCA, 8D, FMEA, SPC, CAPA, inspection standards, ISO 9001/IATF 16949, defect analysis and quality reporting. © 2026 J C Bamford Excavators Ltd.

title: Senior Engineer
jobDescription: Jaipur, IN Job Description © 2026 J C Bamford Excavators Ltd. Senior Engineer Job Description Hands-on experience in CNC machining maintenance and troubleshooting Experience with CNC Machining Centres and VMC machines using Fanuc and Siemens controllers. Hands-on experience in mechanical assembly of machines and sub-assemblies like spindle assembly, ball screw, ATC replacement and alignment. Experience in hydraulic and pneumatic system maintenance and troubleshooting. Experience in preventive and breakdown maintenance of production machines. Strong knowledge of laser cutting machines and welding robots’ maintenance. Ability to read and understand mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic drawings. Good knowledge of mechanical systems and basic electrical systems. Experience in root cause analysis (RCA) and implementing corrective actions. Knowledge of TPM, 5S, and safe maintenance practices. Ability to reduce machine downtime and improve MTTR and MTBF. Experience in Kaizen, cost reduction, and continuous improvement activities. Ability to solve repetitive machine problems using logical troubleshooting. Ability to coordinate with production and quality teams. Ability to guide and train team members to improve technical skills. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure safe work practices. Job Segment: Hydraulics, CNC, Machinist, Electrical, Welding, Engineering, Manufacturing
